findings.title: Admitted submillisecond timestamps lose ordering in Date.parse comparisons
findings.trigger: Owner-projected UTC timestamps include more than three fractional digits. instant() accepts arbitrary digit precision, while Date.parse compares millisecond values.
findings.impact: The model can return evidenceStatus=current and applicability=matched even when validFrom is later than asOf/retrievedAt or retrieval is still in the future within the same millisecond. It can also prematurely return unknown before freshUntil. This violates the documented temporal admission order. No deployed recall/safety decision is claimed: there is no application caller in this candidate, and automaticSelection remains false.
findings.reproduction: Run node edge-cases.mjs from this review artifact; exact inputs/results in edge-results.json. Three failed conformance expectations share this one root cause. A millisecond-only future-retrieval control passes (unknown).
findings.repairRecommendation: Either constrain admitted fractional precision to what the comparator preserves (at most three digits), explicitly document unsupported precision as unknown, and reject rather than truncate it; or compare valid UTC instants at their full admitted fractional precision. Add effective/retrieval/freshUntil/validUntil submillisecond boundary tests. Keep original source timestamps/provenance intact.
findings.origin: New model and new timestamp format in this immutable candidate; not an inherited caller regression.

behaviorReviewed.currentVersusHistorical: Historical kind and missing/current-invalid freshness yield unknown current applicability while preserving scopeMatch and provenance/action snapshots. Explicit inspection/noncompliance/undeclared actions do not establish recall applicability.
behaviorReviewed.identity: Valid string GTIN equivalence preserves leading-zero canonical equivalence; numeric, fullwidth/Arabic-Indic/zero-width barcode forms are unknown. Lot/market/label membership uses exact code-point equality, with no silent case folding, trimming or Unicode normalization.
behaviorReviewed.unicodeEdges: ASCII spacing, case changes, zero-width/null characters, fullwidth and Cyrillic lookalikes are distinct lot identities. Precomposed é vs decomposed e+combining accent is distinct; identical opaque Japanese lot strings match. This is the documented owner-normalized exact-match contract; upstream identity ambiguity must be resolved or retained unknown by Dataset01.
behaviorReviewed.scope: Market remains required even allBatches. allBatches plus lots is unknown; optional malformed label restrictions unknown; date fields are distinct and inclusive calendar bounds validated. Proven scope exclusion takes precedence over missing fields and excludes only this notice.
behaviorReviewed.temporality: Invalid/non-leap/reversed dates and millisecond-scale chronology/freshness conflicts are refused. F1 identifies precision lost for finer admitted timestamps.
behaviorReviewed.snapshots: Provenance/action cloned, input objects unchanged across all 37 probes; automaticSelection false throughout.
